about_the_game:
Thalassic Dice is a seafaring tactical roguelike dice-rolling game. Assemble your crew, battle sea monsters, sail through hazardous waters and escape ship wrecking storms.

Guide your ship and crew through encounters with sea creatures and dangerous hazards.

Crewmates have their own unique dice that help them overcome the challenges of seafaring. Train them and assign them to different positions on your ship to give them new abilities.

Gain experience as you overcome challenges in your voyage, improve your ship and your crew and prepare to protect your ship from the rolling waves and what they might bring with them.

Will your crew specialize in protecting and repairing your ship, escaping any dangers that the sea summons, or maybe they think offense is the best defense?

Find the best synergies between different crewmates to create powerful combos using their unique abilities. Run a crew made entirely of ghosts, take the phrase "skeleton crew" literally or maybe everyone on your crew will be a captain vying for control of the ship. 

Remember - when faced with the challenges of the sea, even a swabbie could rise up and be the key between continuing your voyage or becoming fish food.

Whether you succeed or fail, every voyage is a chance to gain experience and resources. Return to port to upgrade your ship, unlock new crew, improve existing crewmates or invest in the port's infrastructure.

How far will you go to uncover the secrets hiding beneath the waves?
